blocks.text: London, United Kingdom—A power outage at a Google Cloud data centre near London caused serious failures to services on Tuesday, leading to widespread disruptions for several UK banks. Google said in a service health update that most services had returned to normal by 1210 GMT, six hours after the incident began. “We are seeing the recovery of services for most workloads in europe-west2,” the US tech giant said, referring to its London data centre.
